method: critical points by resultant + Newton; ascending gradient branches of every saddle by ODE (scipy solve_ivp, normalized gradient, R_far = 60); union-find merge in decreasing saddle order; older = unbounded component or a local maximum with value > 0; a saddle whose two branches lie in one component is a self-attachment (counted, no death)
